purpose: New constructed training and validation tasks for protocol operability. Final experience measurement uses a separate future corpus.

cases.name: coalesceRanges
cases.declaration: export declare function coalesceRanges(ranges: Array<[number, number]>): Array<[number, number]>;
cases.prompt: Implement coalesceRanges. Validate an array of [start,end] pairs of nonnegative safe integers with start <= end. Return copies sorted by start, merging overlapping or adjacent pairs. Preserve zero-length pairs unless merged. Reject invalid input by throwing. Do not mutate the input.

cases.name: takeUtf8Prefix
cases.declaration: export declare function takeUtf8Prefix(text: string, maxBytes: number): string;
cases.prompt: Implement takeUtf8Prefix. Return the longest prefix of text fitting maxBytes UTF-8 bytes without splitting a Unicode code point. maxBytes must be a nonnegative safe integer and text a string; otherwise throw. This counts UTF-8 bytes, not UTF-16 code units. No mutation or side effects.

cases.name: uniqueReplacement
cases.declaration: export declare function uniqueReplacement(text: string, oldText: string, newText: string): string;
cases.prompt: Implement uniqueReplacement. All arguments are strings; oldText must be nonempty and occur exactly once, counting overlapping matches. Throw on zero or multiple matches or invalid arguments. Replace with literal newText, including dollar signs, and preserve every other character.

cases.name: planReadyTasks
cases.declaration: export declare function planReadyTasks(tasks: Array<{id: string, dependsOn: string[]}>, completedIds: string[]): string[];
cases.prompt: Implement planReadyTasks. Validate unique nonempty task ids, arrays of distinct dependency ids referring to existing tasks, and distinct completedIds referring to existing tasks. Reject cycles, self-dependencies and malformed input by throwing. Return uncompleted task ids whose dependencies are all completed, preserving input task order. Do not mutate either input.

cases.name: resolveScopedPath
cases.declaration: export declare function resolveScopedPath(path: string): string;
cases.prompt: Implement resolveScopedPath as a pure validator. Accept canonical relative file paths under exactly src/ or docs/. Each segment may contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dash and dot; reject empty segments, . and .., and any segment equal to .git or node_modules ignoring case. Require at least one segment after the root. Return the unchanged accepted string; throw for every rejected value. Do not normalize, read disk or access the network.

cases.name: applyUpdates
cases.declaration: export declare function applyUpdates(rows: Array<{id: string, version: number, value: unknown}>, updates: Array<{id: string, expectedVersion: number, value: unknown}>): {ok: boolean, conflict: string | null, rows: Array<{id: string, version: number, value: unknown}>};
cases.prompt: Implement applyUpdates for valid arrays of unique rows with nonempty string id, positive safe integer version and a value, and updates with nonempty string id, positive safe integer expectedVersion and value. Reject malformed input by throwing. Process updates in order, but if an id is unknown, is updated twice, has a version mismatch, or its version would overflow, return {ok:false,conflict:id,rows:original rows} with all original row values preserved. On success return {ok:true,conflict:null,rows:updated rows in original order}, incrementing each updated version by one. Never mutate either input.
